description: Source code for generating and managing Xcode project files within the Chromium build system, including classes and functions for handling targets, sources, dependencies, and project file serialization.

classes.name: XcodeWorkspace
classes.description: Represents an Xcode workspace, responsible for writing workspace files.

classes.name: WorkspaceSources
classes.description: Collects source files to be included in the Xcode project.

classes.name: XcodeProject
classes.description: Constructs and writes an Xcode project (.xcodeproj) based on build targets.

methods.name: WriteWorkspaceDataFile
methods.description: Writes the workspace data XML file.

methods.name: AddSourcesFromBuilder
methods.description: Adds source files from the build targets to the project.

methods.name: AddTargetsFromBuilder
methods.description: Adds build targets (executables and bundles) to the project.

methods.name: AssignIds
methods.description: Assigns unique IDs to all PBXObjects in the project.

methods.name: WriteFile
methods.description: Serializes and writes the final .xcodeproj file.

methods.name: GetTargetsFromBuilder
methods.description: Filters and retrieves relevant build targets for the project.

methods.name: AddBinaryTarget
methods.description: Adds an executable target to the project.

methods.name: AddBundleTarget
methods.description: Adds a bundle target to the project.

methods.name: AddCXTestSourceFilesForTestModuleTargets
methods.description: Adds XCTest source files to test module targets for indexing.

methods.name: AddDependencyTargetsForTestModuleTargets
methods.description: Adds dependencies between test application and test modules.

methods.name: GetConfigOutputDir
methods.description: Calculates output directory relative to build settings.

methods.name: WriteFileContent
methods.description: Writes the content of the .xcodeproj file.
